news_summary: Microsoft president Brad Smith rebutted the administration's H-1B case, saying Microsoft hired more than 9,000 US-born workers last year while PERM filings at eight employers stay suspended.
payoff: None of the eight companies has been charged, and their PERM filings remain frozen.
